name: Grammarly
tagline: AI writing assistant that checks grammar, clarity and tone and drafts text with AI prompts.
bestFor: Grammar, tone and AI drafting across apps
description: Grammarly checks spelling, grammar, clarity and tone wherever you write, through browser extensions, desktop apps and mobile keyboards. It is now part of the Superhuman suite, and paid plans add more AI prompts, plagiarism and AI-text detection, brand tones and style guides.
pros: Free plan includes 100 AI prompts a month
Works in browsers, desktop apps, Microsoft Office and Google Docs
Pro includes plagiarism and AI-text detection plus a style guide and brand tone
cons: Pro costs $30 a month on monthly billing versus $12 a month on annual billing
Pro caps AI prompts at 2,000 per member per month
SAML SSO is available only on Enterprise
freePlanDetails: Spelling, grammar and punctuation checks plus 100 AI prompts per month. No plagiarism checker, brand tones or style guide.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Per account. 100 AI prompts per month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per member. Annual billing is $144 per member per year. Up to 149 seats. 2,000 AI prompts per member per month, 1 brand tone, 1 style guide, plagiarism and AI-text detection.

plans.name: Superhuman Business
plans.notes: Per member. Superhuman suite plan that includes Grammarly with Superhuman Mail, Docs and Go.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Unlimited AI prompts, brand tones and style guides; SAML SSO, SCIM, data loss prevention and dedicated support.

name: QuillBot
tagline: Paraphrasing tool with a summarizer, grammar checker, translator, AI detector and plagiarism checker.
description: QuillBot is a suite of writing tools built around an AI paraphraser that rewrites text in several modes. Premium removes the paraphrase word limit, unlocks more modes, raises the summarizer limit and adds a plagiarism checker.
pros: Free plan paraphrases up to 125 words at a time
Annual Premium works out to $8.33 a month
Extensions for Chrome, Edge and Safari plus a Word add-in and desktop and mobile apps
cons: Free plan has only 2 paraphrasing modes and no plagiarism checker
The plagiarism checker has a monthly cap
3-day money-back guarantee instead of a free trial
freePlanDetails: Paraphraser up to 125 words per use in 2 modes, summarizer up to 1,200 words, translator. No plagiarism checker.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user. Annual billing is $99.95 a year. Unlimited paraphrasing in 9+ modes, summarizer up to 6,000 words, plagiarism checker with a monthly cap.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per seat with volume tiers. Published figures conflict, so no price is shown.

sources.label: eesel.ai: A complete guide to QuillBot pricing 2026

name: Wordtune
tagline: AI rewriting assistant from AI21 Labs that suggests alternative phrasings and summarizes text.
bestFor: Rewriting sentences for clarity and tone
description: Wordtune, made by AI21 Labs, suggests rewrites of your sentences and also checks spelling and grammar. Plans are set by daily rewrite limits and monthly AI summary limits.
pros: Free plan includes unlimited spelling and grammar checks
Unlimited plan removes the rewrite and summary caps
cons: Free plan allows only 10 rewrites a day and 3 AI summaries a month
No refunds, though you can cancel before the next billing cycle
No business plan pricing is published
freePlanDetails: 10 rewrites and AI suggestions per day, 3 AI summaries per month, unlimited spelling and grammar checks.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Per account. 10 rewrites and AI suggestions per day, 3 AI summaries per month.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. 30 rewrites and AI suggestions per day, 15 AI summaries per month. Monthly-billing price not confirmed.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. Unlimited rewrites, AI suggestions and summaries, plus premium support. Monthly-billing price not confirmed.
